project_type: Next.js 14 (app router) client-side multiplayer word game 'Sambung Suku Kata' + Supabase (Postgres RPC + Realtime). All game state is authoritative in SQL RPC (SECURITY DEFINER); clients mutate only via supabase.rpc.
language: TypeScript (React 18, 'use client' components), PostgreSQL/plpgsql for RPC.
build_system: npm + Next.js 14.2.15. No monorepo. Root for all commands: d:\ADO\KiroAI\game-apps (NOT d:\ADO\KiroAI).
test_framework: None. No test runner configured. Verification is type-check + production build only.
verification_instructions: PowerShell echoes build output noisily, so redirect to a file and read the file. Run from d:\ADO\KiroAI\game-apps: `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json *> tsc.log` then read tsc.log (expect empty / exit 0). Then `npx next build *> build.log` then read build.log (expect 'Compiled successfully' / exit 0). Delete tsc.log and build.log afterward. Check $LASTEXITCODE for 0. SQL is NOT run against any database in this task — only authored. Do not run seed scripts or anything that writes to Supabase.
snapshot_or_generated_files: null (no generated/checked-in build artifacts). .next/ is build output, gitignored.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Never run scripts that write to Supabase production. SQL migrations are authored only, applied manually by the user in the Supabase SQL Editor later. functions.sql is re-run in full (all create-or-replace) so editing it directly is fine; schema changes go in a NEW migration-v9.sql (never edit v2..v8).
contribution_requirements: Follow AGENTS.md: minimum sufficient context, minimal change, reuse existing patterns, do not refactor unrelated code. All RPC must `grant execute ... to anon, authenticated` following the pattern at the end of each SQL file. UI text in Indonesian, consistent with existing copy.
key_patterns: Tailwind tokens: rounded-2xl/3xl, bg-white, bg-bg-end, text-ink, text-ink-soft, from-accent-from/to-accent-to, shadow-soft/shadow-soft-sm, animate-pop-in. Supabase client singleton in src/lib/supabaseClient.ts. Realtime room state via src/lib/useRoomRealtime.ts (postgres_changes). Presence via src/lib/usePresence.ts (channel `presence:CODE`). Game state reads via snapshot+subscribe. Sound FX are synthetic Web Audio tones in src/lib/sound.ts via the tone() helper; call unlockAudio() once after user interaction. RPC wrappers live in src/lib/gameActions.ts and are thin `supabase.rpc(name,{params})` calls. Admin PIN pattern: fn_admin_pin() returns '110966'; PIN-gated RPC verifies `if p_pin is distinct from public.fn_admin_pin() then raise exception 'BAD_PIN'`. Identity stored per-room in localStorage via src/lib/session.ts saveIdentity/getIdentity; device id via getDeviceId().

directory_structure: supabase/ holds schema.sql + functions.sql + migration-v2..v8.sql. src/app/ holds Next.js app-router pages (page.tsx = home, room/[code]/page.tsx = lobby, room/[code]/play/page.tsx = game, room/[code]/result/page.tsx = results, kamus-admin/page.tsx = admin). src/lib/ holds supabaseClient, gameActions (RPC wrappers), useRoomRealtime, usePresence, session, sound, dictionary, motion. src/components/ holds UI (PlayerChip, RelaxNotice, TimerRing, WordInput, WordChain, Countdown, TeamBuilder, etc). src/types/game.ts holds shared interfaces.
